subject: EvaNet kickoff: evolved video architectures for activity recognition
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off EvaNet productization for the vision portfolio. Our open-source release ships pretrained models from evolving space-time neural architectures, and the ensemble - RGB and optical-flow streams combined - hits 77.2% on the Kinetics-400 validation set (~19,200 videos in the November 2018 snapshot the release documents). Two partner teams want exactly this for activity recognition on their video archives.

Milestones for Apr 20 - Jul 27: inference reproduction of the released ensemble (the rgb1/rgb2/flow1/flow2 checkpoint combo) by May 22, partner-data evaluation with a served pipeline by Jun 26, launch review pre-read by Jul 20.

Known hard part going in: the flow stream needs precomputed optical flow (the release's sample data ships .npy flow inputs), and partners have raw video only. That pipeline is a first-class deliverable, not a footnote.

Deshawn owns staffing.

Lucia
